question: Do you agree?
description:
I confirm, I don't meet any of the following criteria.

  1. You have not used up the previously prescribed cannabis yourself to the extent that it is completely used up within 10 days as per the doctor’s instructions.
  2. The disadvantages of your previous cannabis consumption outweigh the advantages
  3. You have had a psychosis, schizophrenic episode or other serious mental illness at least once in your life
  4. You have severe cardiovascular disease, liver or kidney dysfunction, shortness of breath or lung disease
  5. You suffer from severe depression with thoughts of harming yourself (suicidal)
  6. In addition to your current symptoms, you have another chronic illness
  7. You work as a car driver
  8. You are allergic to cannabis
